summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the new Panificadora Carvalho admin panel. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (public products list shape incl. 24 seeded items, public order create, login success/failure, /auth/me with & without token, product CRUD auth-guarded incl. 401/404 paths, admin orders list). Frontend: end-to-end UI flow works — /admin login rejects wrong password with admin-login-error, valid credentials reveal Products/Orders tabs, new product created via NewProductModal appears in admin list and on public catalog, toggling available=false renders soldout-<slug> badge and disables add-<slug> on storefront (reverting removes it), storefront cart -> checkout -> delivery address becomes visible/required -> WhatsApp submit reaches order-sent-message and persists order, admin-logout returns to login screen. No console/page errors seen beyond the expected 401 on wrong-password login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: consider returning 400 for invalid JWT decode paths distinct from missing-admin case (currently all 401 with different Portuguese messages — acceptable but could unify).

ProductUpdate.available cannot be set to false via `{k: v for k, v in ... if v is not None}` filter — currently works because False is not None, but the code path is subtle; keep in mind if any BooleanField ever needs an explicit None sentinel.
Admin.js uses window.alert/window.confirm for errors and delete confirmation — functional but replace with toast/modal for better UX consistency.
OrdersTab does not handle 401 (expired token) — a stale token will just leave loading state; consider redirecting to login on 401 like the top-level Admin does.
seed_data_creation: Tests create products/orders prefixed with TEST_ and TEST_UI_ and clean up the products they create. Test orders remain in DB (small, prefixed TEST_) — no destructive action on the 24 seed products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py covers login/me/products CRUD/orders. Run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py -v. Admin token stored in localStorage under key 'padaria_admin_token'. When testing storefront reflection of admin toggles, use a second browser context and reload — no realtime sync.
